description: A long-necked, bipedal-looking dinosaur with a small head, scaly textured skin and sharp claws stands on its hind legs with its long neck arched down toward a nest of speckled round eggs on the ground. Ferns, cycads and dense forest surround it under a dark, stormy sky. Painted in an oil-painting style with warm brown and green tones. No visible text, border or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
